summary: Nintendogs entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Nintendogs
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Nintendo DS cart with exact version and unlocked breed/save state documented

emulation.notes: DS hardware best preserves touchscreen, microphone, and local wireless behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Nintendo DS/DS Lite hardware with original cart

primary.version: Nintendogs: Dalmatian & Friends or regionally complete owned cart
primary.why: Nintendogs is a Nintendo DS pet-simulation built around touchscreen, microphone, and Bark Mode interaction. There are multiple versions with different starting breeds but unlockable breed sharing up to a broader breed set, so the archive route should preserve real DS hardware behavior and record the exact cart/version.
primary.how_to_play: Use Nintendo DS or DS Lite hardware with an owned cart. Record version, region, starting breed set, unlocked breeds, save state, microphone/touchscreen calibration, Bark Mode/local-wireless availability, and dog/profile data.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record save/profile data and version; do not substitute nintendogs + cats for this DS entry.
